{{Top|leg}}
The '''Kroctari''' species were native to the planet [[Kroctar]], the merchant center of the [[Shataum sector/Legends|Shataum sector]]. Though Kroctari could speak [[Galactic Basic Standard/Legends|Basic]], their nasal speech sounded very alien to [[Human/Legends|Human]] ears, as it was interspersed with wheezing and burping noises.

Despite having fought off [[Grand Admiral/Legends|Grand Admiral]] [[Mitth'raw'nuruodo/Legends|Thrawn's]] offensive in [[9 ABY/Legends|9 ABY]], the Kroctari were among the several species in the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] to ask to join the [[Imperial Remnant/Legends|Imperial Remnant]] during the [[Caamas Document Crisis]] of [[19 ABY/Legends|19 ABY]]. Their leader, [[Lord Superior]] [[Bosmihi]] of the [[Unified Factions]], took this action due to the New Republic's perceived inability to help defend them from possibly hostile neighbors. This move was made even though the Kroctari were fairly well-armed for a planetary government, and were deep in New Republic territory.

It is not known if the Kroctari decided to continue to be associated with the Imperial Remnant after the unmasking of the Thrawn imposter [[Flim (Human)|Flim]] at the [[Battle of Yaga Minor (Galactic Civil War)|Battle of Yaga Minor]] and the subsequent signing of the [[Pellaeon–Gavrisom Treaty]] between the Imperial Remnant and the New Republic.
